scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test bun test --path-ignore-patterns='**/*.integration.test.ts' packages/api && bun run -F web test
scripts.typecheck: bun run -F web typecheck && bun run -F api typecheck
scripts.build: bun run -F web build && bun run -F api build
scripts.test:integration: bun run test:integration:up && bun run test:integration:run; CODE=$?; bun run test:integration:down; exit $CODE
scripts.prod:deploy: NODE_ENV=production bun run prod:up && docker image prune -f
